shared_elements: human or humanoid figure in profile/side view
raised arm holding or reaching toward an object
depiction of a figure with an attribute or implement in hand
small filled shapes/plant or object motifs beside the figure
justification: Both surfaces depict an anthropomorphic figure in side view with an arm raised holding an object, and both place smaller subsidiary motifs beside the main figure, but this is about as generic as figural imagery gets. A shows a densely detailed, naturalistically proportioned winged, bearded composite being with elaborate feathering, garment patterning and a stylised plant, while B is a flat, silhouetted, spindly stick-like figure with schematic accompanying signs and animals, so the conventions of depiction and the specific attributes share nothing distinctive.
